teile.text: Munich founders launched Helsing in twenty twenty one to build battlefield intelligence software.
teile.szene: A man in a sharp grey suit with a dark tie and gold pocket watch examines glowing digital tactical maps inside a sleek Munich office under cool cinematic lighting, medium shot.

teile.text: Their system analyses sensor data streams to improve military decisions in real time.
teile.szene: Close up of analytical data displays showing complex radar feeds and strategic terrain maps with bold ink contours and atmospheric shadows in an urban open world game aesthetic.

teile.text: By December twenty twenty four the firm announced its own HX two strike drones.

teile.text: So how did they test it? An AI agent named Centaur flew a jet.
teile.szene: The black haired man with a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses inspects an advanced flight helmet resting on a metal workbench in a hangar, medium close up.

teile.text: Investors pushed the defense tech company valuation to eighteen billion dollars by July twenty
